reorder.title: Stock to reorder
reorder.description: Materials, bases and products at or below their low-stock limit, counting stock at every location together.
reorder.empty: Nothing to reorder: everything is above its low-stock limit.

valuation.title: Stock value
valuation.description: What the stock on hand is worth at each item's average cost.

export.title: Export
export.description: Download every record of a kind: CSV for a spreadsheet, JSON for another program. Costs and prices are included only if you can see them.

errors.COSTS_ONLY: Only members who can see costs can see what stock is worth.
errors.PERIOD_INVALID: The period has to end on or after the day it starts.
errors.SPLIT_INVALID: A mass balance splits only by a lot property that is a list of options.

costOfGoods.title: Cost of goods
costOfGoods.description: What the goods cost over the period, as a tax return asks for it: stock valued at each item's average cost on the day, counting materials only, without labour or purchase tax.
costOfGoods.personalUse: Less stock taken for personal use
costOfGoods.closing: Less stock value at the end
costOfGoods.shipped: Goods shipped in this period cost {{amount}}, less what came back; the rest is stock lost, written off or corrected by a count.
costOfGoods.uncosted_one: {{count}} production run in this period is uncosted: something it used had no cost, so what it made is valued too low.
costOfGoods.uncosted_other: {{count}} production runs in this period are uncosted: something they used had no cost, so what they made is valued too low.

period.title: Over a period
period.invalid: The period has to end on or after the day it starts.

massBalance.title: Mass balance
massBalance.description: What each item had at the start, what came in and went out, and what it had at the end: opening + received + made − used − sold − lost = closing. Split it by a lot property to see each of its options apart.
massBalance.empty: Nothing was in stock or moved in this period.

certifiedVolume.title: Certified volume
certifiedVolume.description: For a certification such as fair trade: how much of each item came in, in lots holding one option of a lot property, against how much of it was sold.
certifiedVolume.choose: Choose a lot property, and the option that means certified.
certifiedVolume.noProperties: Add a lot property with a list of options, such as fair-trade status, to see certified volume.
certifiedVolume.empty: Nothing in lots holding this option came in or was sold in this period.
